title: Nebius Group’s AI Mega Deals And Insider Sales Raise Investor Questions
title_zh: Nebius Group 的人工智能大型交易和内部销售引发投资者质疑
summary: Nebius Group (NasdaqGS:NBIS) has entered into multi year, multi billion dollar infrastructure agreements with Meta and Nvidia, including a $27b partnership with Meta.
summary_zh: Nebius Group（纳斯达克GS：NBIS）已与 Meta 和 Nvidia 签订了多年期、价值数十亿美元的基础设施协议，其中包括与 Meta 的 270 亿美元合作伙伴关系。

title: Carlyle enters $2.8bn deal to acquire majority of MAI Capital
title_zh: 凯雷投资 28 亿美元收购 MAI Capital 多数股权
summary: Galway Holdings, Harvest Partners, and Oak Hill Capital will exit their ownership positions.
summary_zh: Galway Holdings、Harvest Partners 和 Oak Hill Capital 将退出其所有权地位。

title: Carlyle Ups Stake in MAI Capital with Majority Acquisition
title_zh: 凯雷通过收购多数股权增持 MAI Capital 股份
summary: Private equity firm Carlyle has agreed to acquire $72.6B MAI Capital from Galway Holdings at a valuation of $2.8 billion.
summary_zh: 私募股权公司凯雷已同意以 28 亿美元的估值从戈尔韦控股公司收购价值 72.6B 美元的 MAI Capital。
